Non reentrant for the same nm Channel Handle. Parameters (in) nm Channel Handle Identifier of the NM - Channel where the PNC shutdown process is started. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK:Request has been accepted. E_ NOT_ OK: Request has not been accepted.
